```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Workflow

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Modify Details
    Given a patient with ID "12345" and pin-code "1234"
    When I query the patient details
    Then the patient details should be displayed
    And I should be able to modify the patient details
    And the patient pin-code should not be modified to be outside the Zone

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Create Appointment
    Given a patient with ID "12345"
    When I query the patient details
    And I enter details like Speciality, Symptoms, Consultation request, Appointment date
    Then an entry should be created into the Patient Appointment file if the Appointment Request is for next day

  Scenario: Doctor Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees the workflow consultation requests
    Then the doctor should be able to select and provide Consultation

  Scenario: Doctor Enters Diagnosis and Prescribes Medicines
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees the Patient Consultation Requests
    And enters Diagnosis, Prescribes medicines (max 8) and requests for lab tests (optional) max(5)
    Then the prescription should be updated with the diagnosis and medicines
    And the lab tests should be noted down

  Scenario: Chemist Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a chemist
    When the chemist sees the workflow consultation requests
    Then the chemist should be able to select and provide Medicines

  Scenario: Chemist Dispenses Medicines
    Given a chemist
    When the chemist sees the Prescription
    And dispenses medicines
    Then the flag in Prescription should be marked

  Scenario: Lab Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees the workflow consultation requests
    Then the lab should be able to select and note down the Lab Requests

  Scenario: Lab Notes Lab Tests and Adds Report
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees the Prescription
    And notes the lab tests to be done and the Patient details
    Then the flag in prescription should be marked
    And the report should be added

  Scenario Outline: Pin-code Zone Boundary Tests
    Given a patient with ID "12345"
    When I query the patient details
    And I try to modify the pin-code to be outside the Zone
    Then the pin-code should not be modified

  Scenario Outline: Medicine Count Boundary Tests
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees the Patient Consultation Requests
    And enters Diagnosis, Prescribes medicines (max 8) and requests for lab tests (optional) max(5)
    Then the prescription should be updated with the diagnosis and medicines
    And the lab tests should be noted down

  Scenario Outline: Lab Test Count Boundary Tests
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees the Prescription
    And notes the lab tests to be done and the Patient details
    Then the flag in prescription should be marked
    And the report should be added

  Scenario Outline: Appointment Date Boundary Tests
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees the Patient Consultation Requests
    And enters Diagnosis, Prescribes medicines (max 8) and requests for lab tests (optional) max(5)
    Then the prescription should be updated with the diagnosis and medicines
    And the lab tests should be noted down

  Scenario Outline: Negative Test for Exceeding Medicine Limit
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees the Patient Consultation Requests
    And enters Diagnosis, Prescribes medicines (more than 8) and requests for lab tests (optional) max(5)
    Then the prescription should not be updated
    And an error message should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Negative Test for Exceeding Lab Test Limit
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees the Prescription
    And notes the lab tests to be done (more than 5)
    Then the flag in prescription should not be marked
    And an error message should be displayed
```
